name: Floating-Island Chameleon
journalPrompt: A lizard that changes color to match the glowing moss, using its prehensile tail to hang from sky-mangrove roots.

name: Sky-Dragon Fly
journalPrompt: A giant, predatory insect with four independent wings, hunting smaller moths and flies with extreme speed.

name: Prana-Feeder Finch
journalPrompt: A small, brightly colored bird that absorbs atmospheric life-force, its song bringing a sense of calm to travelers.

name: Cloud-Squirrel
journalPrompt: A rodent with exceptionally long, bushy tail used as a rudder, leaping impossible distances in the low-gravity environment.

name: Sky-Faring Jellyfish
journalPrompt: An airborne, translucent organism that drifts on wind currents, filtering high-altitude plankton with stinging tentacles.

name: Lodestone Snail
journalPrompt: A snail with an iron-rich shell that climbs the magnetized cliffs of the floating islands, sensing magnetic fields.

name: Cloud-Lurking Gecko
journalPrompt: A pale green gecko with large, adhesive pads, hunting moths and wasps on the underside of floating rocks.

name: Sky-Faring Otter
journalPrompt: An agile mammal that glides between floating pools using skin membranes, hunting sky-shrews and beetles.

name: Mist-Valley Thrush
journalPrompt: A bird with a sweet, echoing song that nests in the high, misty valleys, feeding on sky-bramble berries.

name: Aero-Weevil
journalPrompt: A beetle with a long snout that drills into the tough, gas-filled gourds to lay its eggs inside.

name: Sky-Faring Crab
journalPrompt: A light-shelled crab that climbs the aerial roots of sky-mangroves, feeding on moss and small insects.

name: Cloud-Weaver Spiderling
journalPrompt: A young spider that uses long silk threads to balloon through the air, traveling between distant floating islands.

name: High-Altitude Falcon
journalPrompt: A swift predator that hunts sky-gulls and finches, nesting on the sheer vertical cliffs of the highest islands.

name: Prana-absorbing Butterfly
journalPrompt: A large butterfly with glowing, translucent wings that feeds on the nectar of prana-lotuses, spreading glowing pollen.

name: Colossal Void-Devourer
journalPrompt: An extinct sauropod-crocodile hybrid resurrected from buried bones via dark Asura magic, crowned with a cursed human visage.

name: Sand-Resurrected Behemoth
journalPrompt: A smaller, desert-bound variant of the Devourer, emerging from the sands of the Gedrosian wastes to hunt nomads.

name: Winged Behemoth Manticore
journalPrompt: An unnatural winged leopard with a human face, forged purely from brick-dust, shadow, and corrupted Asura mantras.

name: Quarry-Spawned Tendua
journalPrompt: A manticore variant that haunts ancient stone quarries, its stone-hard fur blending into the weathered rock walls.

name: Ash-Skinned Courtesan
journalPrompt: An artificial, female humanoid sculpted from river mud and lotus pollen, which later mutated into a flesh-hungry night-stalker.

name: Feral Harappan Night-Stalker
journalPrompt: A malevolent, clay-born construct that slips through the dark streets of Harappa, seeking to drain the warmth of the living.

name: Lunar-Reflection Wraith
journalPrompt: An incorporeal, tactile illusion manifested by lunar radiation refracting on the Great Bath's water, haunting lonely travelers.

name: Stepwell Shadow
journalPrompt: A shadow-lover variant that dwells in deep stepwells, wrapping around victims and pulling them into the dark waters.

name: White-Ash Bride
journalPrompt: A short-lived, sentient female form that coalesces from ritual altar sparks, passionately violent and intensely hot to touch.

name: Ember-Born Dancer
journalPrompt: A fire-bride variant that dances within sacrificial bonfires, throwing sparks that ignite neighboring structures when displeased.

name: Asura-Tainted Gargoyle
journalPrompt: A devolved offshoot of humanity whose skin has calcified into a stone-like hide, animating only at night to hunt.

name: Lethal Cave-Spectre
journalPrompt: A dark, floating entity born from the blood-spills of the first Asura invasion, guarding forgotten mountain tombs.

name: Obsidian-Winged Serpent
journalPrompt: A giant shape-shifting stone serpent with razor-sharp wings of volcanic glass, serving as the progenitor of the Naga clan.

name: Naga Infiltrator
journalPrompt: A secretive, shape-shifting serpent-human hybrid that slips into royal courts, carrying out the will of Takshak.

name: Gorgonopsid War-Beast
journalPrompt: A shaggy-haired Permian predator selectively bred and genetically corrupted by Asuras to serve as heavy shock cavalry.

name: Dimetrodon War-Mount
journalPrompt: A sail-backed synapsid war predator mutated with bio-reactive colors and enhanced aggression for Asura commanders.

name: Estemmenosuchus Executioner
journalPrompt: A massive, armored floodplain omnivore mutated with double jaw-strength, used for public execution rituals in Naraka.

name: Scutosaurus Shield-Beast
journalPrompt: A massive armored herbivore genetically engineered with iron-hard skin plates, utilized as mobile shield barriers in battles.

name: Rajasaurus Ambush-Drake
journalPrompt: A colossal, feathered theropod predator genetically altered with Asura venom, serving as the ultimate fortress guardian.

name: Underworld Blood-Leech
journalPrompt: A giant aquatic parasite of the Naraka rivers that grows up to 3 feet, draining the vitality of anything that falls into the sulfurous waters.

name: Asura-Tainted Bat
journalPrompt: A small, red-eyed bat that has mutated under the influence of Asura planets, feeding on blood and glowing insects.

name: Underworld Water-Snake
journalPrompt: A highly venomous, dark-scaled snake that swims in the sulfuric rivers of Naraka, its bite causing immediate paralysis.

name: Clay-Born Watcher
journalPrompt: An artificial, clay-sculpted eye construct animated by ancient mantras, used by Harappan lords to spy on their courts.

name: Ember-Scattering Sprite
journalPrompt: A small, fleeting spirit born from ritual embers that floats through the air, causing minor fires when displeased.

name: Naga-Kin Sentry
journalPrompt: A semi-anthropomorphic serpent warrior that guards the sacred temples of Takshak, wielding bronze and stone spears.

name: Gorgonopsid Pack-Leader
journalPrompt: A larger, hyper-aggressive gorgonopsid bred by Asura generals to lead war-packs in battle.

name: Dimetrodon Scout-Mount
journalPrompt: A faster, sleek sail-backed synapsid used by Asura scouts to navigate the rugged, volcanic frontiers.

name: Scutosaurus Battering-Ram
journalPrompt: A massive scutosaur mutated with an bone-hard forehead plate, used to break down defensive palisades.

name: Asura-Tainted Owl
journalPrompt: A giant owl with four eyes that has mutated near portals, hunting night-stalkers and small primates.

name: Void-Born Leech
journalPrompt: A giant, 6-foot leech of the Naraka rifts that attaches to larger monsters, draining their magical energy.

name: Beedu
journalPrompt: A pale ray glides above the dune crest, silent, its bladders full of air, casting a shadow the size of a boat.

name: Canopy Langur
journalPrompt: Grey langurs move through the branches overhead, pausing to look down with long-tailed disapproval.

name: Caravan Dromedary
journalPrompt: A single-humped camel chews sideways and regards you with the patience of an animal that has walked further than you have.

name: Cliff Swift
journalPrompt: Swifts cut the air above the grass in long scything arcs, too fast to count.

name: Cognitavi
journalPrompt: A navigator bird watches the water with its head tilted, reading something in it that you cannot, and does not much care that you are here.

name: Delta Egret
journalPrompt: A white egret stands in the shallows, folded like a closed umbrella, then slowly straightens.

name: Delta Monitor
journalPrompt: A long monitor lizard noses along the fish-drying racks, unhurried, entirely certain nobody will stop it.

name: Desert Fox
journalPrompt: A fox with enormous ears watches the road from a low dune, waiting to see whether anything falls off the caravan.

name: Dune Viper
journalPrompt: A sidewinding track crosses the sand ahead of you, fresh, and ends where the snake buried itself.

name: Estuary Sawfish
journalPrompt: Something long moves under the brown water, and for a moment the saw of its snout breaks the surface.

name: Honey-Guide Bird
journalPrompt: A small brown bird calls, hops to the next branch, and calls again. It wants you to follow, and it knows where the comb is.

name: Mangrove Crab
journalPrompt: A heavy crab sidles between the mangrove roots, one claw raised like a man carrying something awkward.

name: Megalosaurus
journalPrompt: Appeared during the Naraka portal event; killed Nirigili’s Elephantbird mount.

name: Plateau Ibex
journalPrompt: An ibex stands on a ledge no wider than your hand and looks down at you without concern.

name: Plateau Wolf
journalPrompt: A lean wolf crosses the open ground at a trot. It is not hunting you; it is following a line its clan has walked for generations.

name: Reed Python
journalPrompt: A thick python lies banked in the reeds, digesting, in no hurry to be anywhere.

name: Sand Skink
journalPrompt: A skink pours itself into the dune and is gone, swimming under the surface like a fish.

name: Tendua
journalPrompt: A spotted cat watches from the reed line with eyes set forward like a person's, and you understand that you are being considered.

name: Tendua Manticore
journalPrompt: Birthed when Nila desecrated Kavik's tower with forbidden Asura mantras. Six-foot winged leopard with human face that hunted Lothal's infants. Central to Tendua Crisis.

name: Vṛkṣaśmara
journalPrompt: Something grey shifts high in the canopy, too large for a monkey, and the leaves close over it again.
